title: ては and ても
summary: ても means "even if" and joins two clauses without taking sides; ては points at an unwelcome result and shrinks to ちゃ in casual speech.

blocks.text: Both endings sit after the **て-form** and add a particle. Notice which particle: **も** is the "also / even" particle, and **は** is the topic particle that draws a line around something. Their personalities come straight from that.
ても: even if, even though

も says "even as far as that". 雨が降っても means "even going as far as rain". The result that follows is simply not stopped by it, and it can be good or bad. This is the same も that appears in でも, where で is the て-form of だ.

blocks.jp: 雨が降っても公園に行く。
blocks.en: Even if it rains, I will go to the park.
Even though it is cold, I go for a walk.

blocks.text: Turn ても into a question and you have permission: "even if I did that, would it be fine?"

blocks.jp: ここに座ってもいいですか。

blocks.text: ては: that would be a problem

は narrows things down: **"as soon as you do just this"**. The result tends to be **unwelcome**: a ban, a complaint, a trouble. Because it is so often used to forbid, casual speech squeezes ては into **ちゃ** (and では into **じゃ**).

blocks.jp: 雨が降っては遠足に行けない。
blocks.en: If it rains, we cannot go on the trip (and that is a nuisance).

blocks.jp: ここで泣いては恥ずかしい。
blocks.en: It would be embarrassing to cry here.

blocks.jp: ここで寝ちゃだめだよ。

items: **て-form + も**: even if / even though, any kind of result.
**て-form + は**: when that happens, trouble; often forbids.
**ては → ちゃ**, **では → じゃ** in casual speech.

questions.note: ても: even if, and the result goes ahead.
questions.en: Even if it rains, I will go out.

questions.prompt: このペンを使っ＿＿いいですか。
questions.note: て-form + もいい asks permission.

questions.prompt: ここでたばこをすっ＿＿いけません。
questions.note: て-form + はいけません forbids.
ては shortens to ちゃ.
では shortens to じゃ after ん.
ても: even though; the result is not stopped.
questions.en: Even though it was cold, I opened the window.

questions.prompt: 日曜日＿＿、仕事があります。
questions.note: Noun + でも: even on.
questions.en: Even on Sunday I have work.

questions.prompt: ここで食べてはいけません。
questions.note: て-form + はいけない forbids.

questions.prompt: あしたは休んでもいいです。
options: It is fine to take tomorrow off
